status: illustrative partial cost model, not validated sizing or complete quote

formulas.hot_provisioned_bytes: hourly_original_bytes * (outage_hours + normal_hot_hours) * hot_copies * (1 + hot_headroom); round each equally loaded worker up to GiB
formulas.pack_payload_bytes: pack_mib * 2**20 * fill_ratio; no padding charge for unused target capacity
formulas.verification_heads: one HEAD per successful initial/rewrite PUT, charged at Tier2 GET rate
formulas.retirement_requests: one conditional zero-byte retirement PUT and one verification HEAD per pack; steady-state retired packs approximated by initial_puts + rewrite_puts
formulas.dead_bytes_illustration: hourly_original_bytes * cleanup_hours; assumes steady expiry at incoming byte rate and every dead byte stays for the whole deadline
formulas.s3_average_bytes: daily_original_bytes * storage_days + dead_bytes_illustration + rewrite_overlap_bytes; no storage credit for hot residency
formulas.internet_and_nlb: unchanged earlier baseline for the same incoming workload and external_percent
